senses.gloss: m. (contr. of אדסא, v. הדס) myrtle. Targ. II, Esth. II, 7; a. e.
units: R. Hash. 23ᵃ הדס א׳ hadas (Is. XLI, 19) is asa.
<cite ref="Pesachim 56a:4">Pes. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ רדא׳</he> Ar., Ms. O. (ed. <cite ref="D01029"><he>דרא</he></cite>) fresh (moist) myrtle.
<cite ref="Berakhot 9b:17">Ber. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>דאמטיית א׳ וכ׳</he> you had to carry a myrtle-tree to the palace (when forced into public labor, v. <cite ref="A02108"><he>אַנְגַרְיָא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 44a:2">Snh. 44ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>א׳ דקאי ביני וכ׳</he> a myrtle between willows still is a myrtle by name, and people call it a myrtle.—Pl. <he>אָסַיָּא</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 8:15">Targ. Esth. VIII, 15</cite>.—
